clusters.headline: Passenger Trains Collide Near Giza Resulting In Multiple Casualties
aiSummaryBullets: At least seven people were killed and more than 100 others sustained injuries in a train collision near Giza.
The incident involved two trains traveling in the same direction, which resulted in the derailment and overturning of multiple carriages.

clusters.headline: Egyptian National Football Team Appoints Ali Maher As Head Coach
aiSummaryBullets: The Egyptian national football team has confirmed the departure of its previous coach, Hassan.
Ali Maher has been appointed as the new head coach for the national team.
